描述_EN: while the wares produced at the yaozhou kiln complex enjoyed popularity from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368), these bowls exhibit the olive green glaze and dense surface designs common to the yaozhou wares of the northern song period. moulded designs were an important feature of youzhou ware. the celadon glaze was then applied to the dish, pooling in the crevices and laying thinly on raised areas. multiple dishes could then be made by forming clay to this mould and pressing the walls to the appropriate thickness. a mould was then made of the dish and fired, creating a convex ‘hump-mould’. through firing, the pooled areas grew darker in colour and the thinly glazed areas more transparent, creating the illusion of light and shadows in the surface design. the process began with a master dish, which would have been carved by hand and fired. these bowls are examples of the yaozhou wares typical of the northern song dynasty (960-1127). the dish in the centre is an example of the this technique, which made detailed designs much more efficient to produce.
描述_ZN: 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州窑群生产的瓷器都很受欢迎，这些碗表现出北宋时期耀州瓷器常见的橄榄绿釉和密集的表面图案。 模塑设计是幽州器物的一个重要特征。 然后将青瓷釉涂在盘子上，在缝隙中积聚，在凸起的地方薄薄地铺上。 然后可以通过在这个模具上形成粘土并将壁压到适当的厚度来制作多个盘子。 然后在盘子上做一个模具并烧制，形成一个凸起的 "驼峰模具"。 通过烧制，汇集的区域颜色越来越深，薄釉的区域越来越透明，在表面设计中创造出光和影的幻觉。 这个过程是从一个主盘开始的，它将被手工雕刻和烧制。 这些碗是北宋时期（960-1127）典型的耀州器物的例子。 中间的盘子是这种技术的一个例子，它使详细的设计更有效地生产。
